description: This file defines interfaces for a persistent storage system within the WPEFramework, including store operations, inspection, and storage limits, with event notifications for value changes.

classes.name: IStore2
classes.description: Interface for a key-value store with namespace support and event notifications.

classes.name: IStoreInspector
classes.description: Interface for inspecting storage contents, such as keys, namespaces, and sizes.

classes.name: IStoreLimit
classes.description: Interface for setting and getting storage limits per namespace.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for value changes.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the store with a specified TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and its TTL from the store.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.
